prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select standard adoption for ready-to-play pets or custom creation to build a unique desktop companion.", "Path Options"]
1: ["Don't worry: you can customize your pet's appearance, behavior, and settings anytime after setup."]
2: ["Signing in ensures your pet data, items, and desktop progress stay saved to your account."]
3: ["Secure Desktop Companion Sync", "Sign in to keep your desktop pet saved across sessions and devices.", "Automatic Cloud Sync"]
4: ["Review Your Companion Details", "Check your pet details before finalizing the official adoption certificate.", "Pet Overview"]
5: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select your favorite pet breed to begin adoption.", "Popular Choice"]
6: ["We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!"]
7: ["Generating Your Pet", "Explore Companion Teasers", "Swipe through helpful tips while your desktop pet hatches.", "Desktop Tips"]
8: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Quick guide on summoning, hiding, and interacting with your companion.", "Controls Overview"]
9: ["Your pet is live! Access controls or hide your pet anytime via the desktop system tray icon."]
